answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes. Each identity must trade with 14 distinct partners in three meadow clusters. An atlas lists every edge in public, exposing a ring as one signature repeated. Each trade emits a signal naming both keys; a borrowed edge names its lender and burns both bonds. The k-th fake pays 44+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,541,500 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 44 once and keeps its share.
